data.content_ref: inline:The notion that the sequence behaves as a pseudo-random walk on binary representations (SRC_001) shares mechanism with the information-theoretic entropy of the bit-stream (SCR_005), suggesting that the 'drop' to 1 is a result of stochastic bit-attrition. This relation is refuted if the parity sequence is proven to have a deterministic structure that prevents the average slope from being negative.
